![](figures/figureS_alad_cohort/figureS_alad_cohort.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label alad-cohort >}}.
ALAD cohort, RISE factor matrices, and collinearity and stability of RISE and CPD components.** ({{< panel alad-cohort cohort >}}) Schematic of the ALAD cohort data\ [@doi:10.1016/j.healun.2024.02.007].
({{< panel alad-cohort factors genes >}}) RISE factor matrices representing component loadings of conditions and genes; conditions are grouped by ALAD status, then six-month outcome (color strips).
For visualization, genes outside the top 10% by weight in any component are omitted and each component is normalized to its largest absolute loading.
({{< panel alad-cohort cp-collinearity >}}) Largest absolute cosine between the condition, sender, receiver, and LR pair factors of any two CPD components across ranks, as the median (line and points) and interquartile range (band) over 10 seeded SVD starts per rank.
({{< panel alad-cohort rise-fms >}}) RISE gene factor and ({{< panel alad-cohort cpd-fms >}}) CPD LR pair factor FMS of each component across leave-one-patient-out jackknife replicates (n = 45), and, right of the dashed line, the aggregate FMS (mean over components) of each jackknife and re-initialization (seed only, n = 100) replicate.
Each replicate's components were matched to the reference's by Hungarian matching.
Boxes show the median and interquartile range and whiskers show the most extreme values within 1.5-times the interquartile range.

![](figures/figureS_ibd_rank_selection/figureS_ibd_rank_selection.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label ibd-rank-selection >}}.
IBD rank selection.** ({{< panel ibd-rank-selection cohort >}}) Schematic of the IBD cohort data\ [@doi:10.1038/s41588-026-02634-7].
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection rise-rank-selection >}}) RISE R^2^X across ranks of the fit on all data and, in BiCV, of the fit on the training block (BiCV train) and its prediction of the held-out block (BiCV test); mean ± SD over 10 repeats per rank.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection bicv-test >}}) BiCV test R^2^X from ({{< panel ibd-rank-selection rise-rank-selection >}}) on its own magnified axis.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection cp-r2x-starts >}}) CPD fit R^2^X across ranks: the median (line) and range (band) over 10 seeded SVD starts per rank.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection cp-collinearity >}}) Largest absolute cosine between the LR pair factors of any two CPD components across ranks, for each start (points), colored by whether the start reaches the solution most starts reach at its rank (blue) or another solution (grey).
Boxes show the median and interquartile range and whiskers show the most extreme values within 1.5-times the interquartile range.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection cp-minima >}}) Number of the 10 starts reaching each distinct solution across ranks (starts joined at FMS ≥ 0.95): the solution most starts reach (blue, bottom) and each other solution (grey), colored as in ({{< panel ibd-rank-selection cp-collinearity >}}).
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection mode-collinearity >}}) Largest absolute cosine between the condition, sender, and receiver factors of any two CPD components across ranks, as the median (line and points) and interquartile range (band) over the starts.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection factors genes >}}) RISE factor matrices at the selected rank representing component loadings of conditions and genes.
({{< panel ibd-rank-selection eigenstate-heatmap >}}) RISE cell-type--eigen-state associations derived from RISE rank-60 projection matrices: mean RISE projection of each cell type's cells onto each eigen-state.

![](figures/figureS_ibd_associations/figureS_ibd_associations.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label ibd-associations >}}.
Association of CPD components and covariates with IBD biopsy type.** ({{< panel ibd-associations cp-associations >}}) One-way ANOVA η^2^ of each CPD component's condition loadings against each IBD biopsy categorization.
\*: q < 0.05, Benjamini--Hochberg corrected across all categorizations and components.
({{< panel ibd-associations status-loadings >}}) CPD component ({{< panel ibd-associations status-loadings.1 >}}) 3 and ({{< panel ibd-associations status-loadings.2 >}}) 4 condition loadings by CD inflammation status.
Violins show the distribution of loadings, points show individual biopsies, and ticks mark the median.
One-way ANOVA F and η^2^, with p Benjamini--Hochberg corrected across all categorizations and components.
({{< panel ibd-associations lineage-proportions >}}) Fraction of each biopsy's cells in each coarsely annotated cell type for healthy, CD uninflamed, and CD inflamed samples, on a square-root scale.
Boxes show the median and interquartile range and whiskers show the most extreme values within 1.5-times the interquartile range.
q: Kruskal--Wallis test across the three groups, Benjamini--Hochberg corrected across cell types.
({{< panel ibd-associations covariates >}}) One-way ANOVA η^2^ of each biopsy covariate and coarse cell-type fraction against each biopsy categorization, with binary covariates coded 0/1.
\*: p < 0.05, uncorrected.

![](figures/figureS_comparator_rank_selection/figureS_comparator_rank_selection.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label comparator-rank-selection >}}.
Rank selection of the label-based comparators.** Each method's own rank selection on coarse and fine labels, ALAD and IBD together; dashed lines mark each cohort's chosen rank, and red circles the Kneedle elbow.
PB, pseudobulk CPD; TC2C, Tensor-cell2cell; STAC, STACCato.
({{< panel comparator-rank-selection pb-fit-coarse pb-fit-fine >}}) Pseudobulk CPD fit R^2^X, ({{< panel comparator-rank-selection pb-collinearity-coarse pb-collinearity-fine >}}) largest absolute cosine between the LR pair factors of any two components, and ({{< panel comparator-rank-selection pb-minima-coarse pb-minima-fine >}}) share of starts at the most common minimum, over 10 seeded starts per rank; lines show the median and bands the range over starts.
({{< panel comparator-rank-selection tc2c-elbow-coarse tc2c-elbow-fine >}}) Tensor-cell2cell normalized error (mean and range over 10 random starts), ({{< panel comparator-rank-selection tc2c-congruence-coarse tc2c-congruence-fine >}}) largest congruence product between two components of a start, and ({{< panel comparator-rank-selection tc2c-minima-coarse tc2c-minima-fine >}}) share of starts at the most common minimum.
({{< panel comparator-rank-selection stac-shares-coarse stac-shares-fine >}}) STACCato eigenvalue share of each component of each mode's unfolding; the dashed line marks the 1% cutoff, and cores are given as condition × LR pair × sender × receiver.

![](figures/figureS_comparator_ibd_and_depth/figureS_comparator_ibd_and_depth.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label comparator-ibd-and-depth >}}.
Comparator recovery of the IBD components, and detection depth in every method's components.**
({{< panel comparator-ibd-and-depth ibd-best >}}) Largest squared cosine (cos^2^) between each IBD CCC-RISE component's LR pair loadings and one LR column of each comparator fit, as in {{< fig 5 cos2-grid >}}.
({{< panel comparator-ibd-and-depth ibd-containment >}}) Fraction of each IBD component's LR pair loadings reconstructed by the best combination of all LR columns of each comparator fit, as in {{< fig 5 span-containment >}}.
({{< panel comparator-ibd-and-depth depth >}}) Absolute Spearman correlation across conditions between the condition loadings of each CCC-RISE component or comparator LR column and the median number of genes detected per cell, per fit, ALAD (left) and IBD (right); circles, coarse labels; triangles, fine labels.
STACCato columns' condition loadings are the leading vector of each LR component's core slice mapped through the condition factor.
Boxes show the median and interquartile range and whiskers the range.
p: Kruskal--Wallis test across the fits of each cohort.
\*: the fit's components track depth more than the cohort's other components (one-sided Mann--Whitney U test, Benjamini--Hochberg corrected within the cohort, q < 0.05) and the cohort's Kruskal--Wallis p < 0.05.
PB, pseudobulk CPD; TC2C, Tensor-cell2cell; STAC, STACCato; C and F, coarse and fine labels.

![](figures/figureS_comparator_missed_alad/figureS_comparator_missed_alad.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label comparator-missed-alad >}}.
Comparator LR columns that are not part of a CCC-RISE component in ALAD.** PB, pseudobulk CPD; STAC, STACCato; C and F, coarse and fine labels; LR columns are named by method (P, S) and number.
({{< panel comparator-missed-alad share >}}) Share of each pseudobulk CPD and STACCato LR column's squared LR pair loading on the top LR pairs of one CCC-RISE component, the component holding the largest share, as for related columns in {{< fig 5 pair-columns >}}; the dashed line marks 0.5.
({{< panel comparator-missed-alad associations >}}) Each column's strongest association with an outcome grouping, as effect size (η^2^) against q (one-way ANOVA, Benjamini--Hochberg corrected across the groupings and components of each fit), beside the associated CCC-RISE components (blue); the dashed line marks q = 0.05, and the box lists, per grouping, the columns and CCC-RISE components with q < 0.05.
({{< panel comparator-missed-alad contents >}}) Top LR pairs of the columns below 0.5 in ({{< panel comparator-missed-alad share >}}), sized by absolute loading relative to the column's largest; the CCC-RISE row shows each LR pair's largest such value in any CCC-RISE component.
Bold names and red boxes mark the columns with q < 0.05 in ({{< panel comparator-missed-alad associations >}}) that carry an LR pair CCC-RISE lacks: one outside the top LR pairs of CCC-RISE components that is not homophilic adhesion.

![](figures/figureS_comparator_missed_ibd/figureS_comparator_missed_ibd.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label comparator-missed-ibd >}}.
Comparator LR columns that are not part of a CCC-RISE component in IBD.** As {{< fig comparator-missed-alad >}}, for IBD.
({{< panel comparator-missed-ibd share >}}) Share of each LR column's squared LR pair loading on the top LR pairs of one CCC-RISE component.
({{< panel comparator-missed-ibd associations >}}) Each column's strongest association with a biopsy grouping; H, healthy; CD, Crohn's disease; U and I, CD uninflamed and inflamed.
({{< panel comparator-missed-ibd contents >}}) Top LR pairs of the columns below 0.5 in ({{< panel comparator-missed-ibd share >}}).

![](figures/figureS_comparator_single_cell/figureS_comparator_single_cell.svg){width="6.5in"}

**{{< label comparator-single-cell >}}.
Single-cell comparison of CCC-RISE populations.** ({{< panel comparator-single-cell scriabin-seeds >}}) Agreement between random seeds of the LR sets of Scriabin's interaction programs and of the top LR pairs of CCC-RISE components, as the Jaccard index of each pair of seeds; bars mark medians.
({{< panel comparator-single-cell alad-weights >}}) ALAD and ({{< panel comparator-single-cell ibd-weights >}}) IBD per-cell sender against receiver weight on each CPD component, each relative to its largest value; dashed lines mark the 0.3 cutoff (τ) defining each component's sender, receiver, and both populations.
({{< panel comparator-single-cell alad-tau >}}) ALAD and ({{< panel comparator-single-cell ibd-tau >}}) IBD fraction NICHES+ of each sender (solid) and receiver (dotted) population minus the fraction predicted by cell type, as in {{< fig 5 niches-fraction >}}, across cutoffs τ; the grey line marks the 0.3 cutoff used throughout, and the dashed line no difference.

{{< include figures/tables/alad_outcome_groups.md >}}

**{{< label alad-outcome-groups >}}.
ALAD samples by outcome group.** Number of BAL samples in each ALAD status and six-month outcome group the analyses compare.
Indented groups are subgroups of the group above them.
Two of the 45 patients were sampled twice, in different groups.
